mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 60 degrees over at Reddan Soccer Park, with a full moon visible.

The city has launched a new rain barrel rebate program offering credits to property owners who install at least 35-gallon barrels, and residents are also encouraged to vote for the upcoming I Voted sticker contest before August 7.
We have a busy lineup today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, while tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident from last Wednesday, a 23-year-old local man was taken into custody for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.

The Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. While today's flavor is unknown, we look forward to seeing what they serve up for the community once they open for the day.
